newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch police net major cocaine haul.
newsitem.headline: Dutch police net major cocaine haul.

text.p: Police said on Sunday they had seized seized a tonne of cocaine with a street value of 150 million guilders ($83 million) hidden in a false wall of a container on the back of a lorry.
The discovery was made by detectives with sniffer dogs after a tip-off from colleagues in Belgium, where the vehicle had discharged a cargo of oranges before parking at Hoorn, north of Amsterdam.
Police said they expected to make a number of arrests soon. They could not say where the drugs had originated or if they were intended for the Dutch market or export.
